name: Albendea (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, white above and red below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Albendea (a tower with crossed swords above waves on white).
history: Municipal flag of Albendea; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Albendea arms — tower with crossed swords above waves
